summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel RT (Live Patch 5 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 16)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.12.0-160000.26.1 fixes various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-53131: netfilter: require Ethernet MAC header before using eth_hdr() (bsc#1269775).
- CVE-2026-63794: KVM: SVM: Fix page overflow in sev_dbg_crypt() for ENCRYPT path (bsc#1271965).
- CVE-2026-63795: 9p: avoid putting oldfid in p9_client_walk() error path (bsc#1272136).
- CVE-2026-63887: scsi: target: iscsi: Bound iscsi_encode_text_output() appends to rsp_buf (bsc#1272386).
- CVE-2026-63939: KVM: SEV: Compute the correct max length of the in-GHCB scratch area (bsc#1272692).
- CVE-2026-64054: net: shaper: reject duplicate leaves in GROUP request (bsc#1272895).
- CVE-2026-68158: libceph: Fix multiplication overflow in decode_new_up_state_weight() (bsc#1276303).
